title: ODA AC1024 LAYER plot-style writer failure isolation
sources: The two locally generated ODA AC1024 mesh samples and hashes are identified by p6-oda-ac1024-visualstyle-extension-graph-2026-11-15.json. No drawing fixture or derivative is committed.
sourceGraph: LibreDWG 0.14 decodes source NOD -> ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME DICTIONARYWDFLT handle 0x12, whose Normal entry and default pointer target ACDBPLACEHOLDER 0x13 owned by the dictionary. The two source LAYER records (0 and Defpoints) each have plotstyle H5 target 0x13 and material H5 target Global MATERIAL 0x21. ODA returned DXF independently places group 390=13 on each layer and resolves the same named/default dictionary and placeholder graph.
adapterCapture: For the polyface input, libdxfrw captures two LAYER records with valid DXF fields, ACI 7, Continuous linetype, plot-style handle 19 and material handle 33; both getDxfPlotStyleHandle/getDxfMaterialHandle and validateDxf succeed. The parser-recorded source handle spans and their independent peer comparison are recorded separately below; emitted output mapping remains open.
isolation: For each sample, a scratch process imports a fresh drawing and calls partial-policy export once with untouched source data and once after clearing only the in-memory LAYER plot-style fields. Untouched runs refuse without output. Clearing those fields makes serialization advance to OBJECTS, which then refuses at TABLESTYLE; no output is published. This deliberate loss is only an isolation experiment and is not an implementation or an acceptable fix. The CLI independently reports the untouched failure at LAYER table.
codeBoundary: The general LAYER writer rejects a nonzero non-default group-390 source handle when no reference resolver is configured. The adapter has a separate AC1027 source-bound layer route with source publication, material/plot-style graph snapshots, mapped output and finalization checks; it is not automatically applicable to this AC1024 two-layer profile. The generic DWG adapter currently strips unqualified material links, so fixing only plot-style transport would not establish lossless layer output.
nextAction: Bind the two source-backed layers to the source Global material and Normal plot-style dictionary/default/placeholder graph, adapt the selected output planner for the bounded AC1024 profile, and prove exact 347/390 fields, mapped identities/owners and closure with ASCII/Binary readback, invalid graph and source mutation refusal, rollback/retry, and LibreCAD compatibility. Preserve strict HEADER and whole-document gates.
limits: Generated sources, not independent producer-authored drawings.
ODA is an independent conversion/projection but does not alone prove user-visible plotting semantics.
Scratch source mutation intentionally loses a reference and must never be used to promote support.
This finding does not qualify native consumers, material output, whole-document output or strict HEADER admission.
odaSpecification: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.54 orders the common table references followed by plotstyle hard pointer (R2000+), material (R2007+) and linetype hard pointer; the typed code-5 material role is corroborated by LibreDWG and prior p6-ac1018plus-layer-body-handle-role-spans-2026-11-09.json.

adapterHandleSpans.scope: Parser-recorded bit offsets within each decoded LAYER object handle stream, not independent byte-level re-decoding or physical-file offsets. Both generated DWGs exhibit the same offsets and target values.
adapterHandleSpans.crosscheck: LibreDWG JSON independently reports the plotstyle, material and linetype source target values and H5 roles; ODA-returned DXF binds the plotstyle target through group 390 to Normal.

frameCrosscheck.method: For both hash-bound source DWGs, debug traces identify the AcDb:AcDbObjects page at physical 0x680 with 32-byte page header and compressed payload at 0x6a0. Decompress the first page with the existing R2004-family codec; locate layer frames at decoded object-map offsets 767 and 799, then validate each frame CRC with DwgObjectFrame. A scratch probe reads the three handle tokens directly from each validated body using parser-recorded bit offsets; this second extraction uses libdxfrw codecs and is not an independent DWG decoder.
frameCrosscheck.limits: Offsets are from the decoded object map; the adapter now joins its optional raw receipts to matching typed publications and frozen source snapshots. The scratch frame/bit/CRC checks share libdxfrw code; LibreDWG independently corroborates role and targets, not these bit offsets.

optionalReaderReceipt.implementation: For AC1024 only, the reader optionally captures at most the exact 0 and Defpoints layer source frames after successful table parsing, validates each frame CRC, retains the bounded raw body and object-map location/ordinal, and publishes them through a separate opt-in DRW_DwgAc1024LayerSourceHandler. Duplicate names, allocation failure, oversized bodies or invalid frames clear the optional evidence without altering ordinary table callbacks. Existing DRW_Interface vtables are not changed.
optionalReaderReceipt.limits: The raw source receipt is now joined to adapter publication identities and immutable typed source snapshots. Material/plot-style graph targets and emitted DXF remain unqualified; LAYER output stays gated. A source with only one selected layer can emit one receipt and is not admitted by the two-layer evidence gate.
optionalReaderReceipt.validation: CMake test libdxfrw_dwg_ac1024_layer_source_receipt generates AC1024 and AC1021 DWGs from scratch, confirms two receipts and typed layer matches for AC1024, no receipt for AC1021, repeated-read reset, truncated raw-body refusal and same-decoder retry, and successful read by an unchanged LibreCAD_3-style consumer. The same observer matched both locally generated ODA sources. The lc3_compat_check target compiled under the existing warning policy.
optionalReaderReceipt.cleanSourceInventory: 1197 released files; the new test is generated at runtime, no DWG/DXF fixture is committed

adapterSourceBinding.scope: The in-tree adapter retains at most two optional AC1024 frame receipts and two same-generation typed frame publications; duplicates, invalid identities and excess layer publications fail the evidence gate. Each current layer must match its immutable import-time snapshot and the exact receipt handle, object-map offset/ordinal/space and publication identity.
adapterSourceBinding.reparse: The gate reparses the CRC-validated captured body as a LAYER and separately reparses its common handle shell. It compares the layer fields, common links and four ordered handle spans against the frozen source snapshot; the separately resolved linetype name remains a graph dependency, not a raw-frame field.
adapterSourceBinding.tests: Fixture-free generated AC1024 source and both locally generated ODA sources pass. The test changes a publication offset, raw frame byte, typed layer name and evidence failure state; each mutation is refused and the restored source is accepted on the same adapter. The earlier separate-interface receipt test also passes.
adapterSourceBinding.cleanSourceInventory: 1198 released files, with generated test inputs only
adapterSourceBinding.limits: This is source receipt and publication binding, not material or plot-style graph closure, output qualification, complete export or semantic support.
